title: CRITICAL: NBA TF thesis↔outcome leakage re-detected
rationale: Leakage detected on nba. The thesis field contains a numeric value that correlates >0.80 with resolved excess_return/pnl_pct. This is the $13K bug class. Remove any field that embeds future-outcome data into the prompt or signal calculation.

title: PQTF: negative Sharpe agents (llama-contra(Sharpe=-11.225), qwen-quant(Sharpe=-21.319))
rationale: PQTF agents llama-contra(Sharpe=-11.225), qwen-quant(Sharpe=-21.319) have negative Sharpe ratios, meaning risk-adjusted returns are below zero. Review their position sizing — they may be over-sizing IV-expansion bets near event dates. Introduce a per-agent VaR-based position cap (already tracked as avg_var_95) that reduces notional when Sharpe drops below 0 over a 10-day window.

title: PQTF: near-zero session-Jaccard (agents too uncorrelated?)
rationale: PQTF fleet Jaccard mean=0.024 is near zero. While low correlation is generally good, near-zero may indicate agents are ignoring each other's signals entirely (no coalition pacts). Review pact count: if <2 pacts/day fleet-wide, the mandatory coalition prompt may be broken.
